test_title: PYST 10: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the set of classes the relationship among which is best illustrated by the given Venn diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2c868b091e8c75fced743a85e99dd04b420e6ff490510f5cfd3b64a5f45f86c.png]
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given relations is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48b3c9ed3e495c2044638eea39bf87ed9db844554ac54486ec44b07bb5cc47a5.png] 

__A woman can be an entrepreneur and philanthropist. And an entrepreneur can be a woman and philanthropist.__

Hence, the correct answer is **"Entrepreneurs, Women, Philanthropists".**
